question: Which of the following was founded by Sir Stamford Raffles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The city of **Singapore** was founded by **Sir Stamford Raffles** in 1819.
 
• He is **known for establishing Singapore** as a key **British trading post **and a strategic location for maritime trade between the East and the West. 
 
• His **vision helped transform Singapore into a major port city,** laying the foundation for its future development.
 
• Raffles recognized the strategic importance of Singapore’s location at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula,
 
 
• which was ideal for controlling trade routes between India, China, and the rest of Southeast Asia.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sir Stamford Raffles

 
 
• ​Sir Stamford Raffles was a British statesman and an official of the British East India Company.
 
• Raffles had a vision for Singapore as a free port, meaning it would have low tariffs and open trade policies.
 
• In 1819, Raffles negotiated with the local Malay ruler, Sultan Hussein Shah, to establish a British settlement in Singapore.
